test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The easiest ________ to get started is to use your imagination and maturity.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'approach'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• To fill in the blanks, we need a word whose meaning is close to **way or attitude.**
 
• Let us look at the **meanings** of other words:
 
 
• **Stretch: **straighten or extend.
 
• **Approach: **a way of addressing an issue.
 
• **Work: **a task or an activity.
 
• **Thinking: **process of being rational or considering something.
 
 
 
• From the meanings of all the words, we can say that 'approach' is the most appropriate answer.

 **Hence, the correct sentence will be:** The easiest **approach** to get started is to use your imagination and maturity.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us see the **synonyms **of the given words:
